column1: What is the mathematical function of clamp(MIN, VAL, MAX) in CSS?
column2: It clamps a value between an absolute lower bound (MIN) and upper bound (MAX) based on a preferred dynamic expression (VAL).

column1: In --font-size-h1: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw + 1rem, 3.75rem), what triggers the font size to scale dynamically?
column2: The viewport width unit (5vw) within the preferred value expression.

column1: What browser engine phase is skipped when an element animates using transform instead of top or margin?
column2: The Layout (Reflow) and Paint phases are skipped, running directly on the GPU Compositor thread.

column1: Why does transform: translateY(-2px) run at 60/120fps compared to margin-top: -2px?
column2: transform manipulates the element's composite layer directly without invalidating the geometry or triggering geometry recalculation of sibling nodes.

column1: What CSS property creates a smooth color transition from white to neutral background in the hero section?
column2: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, var(--color-bg) 100%);

column1: What is the default direction of a CSS linear-gradient() if no angle or direction is specified?
column2: to bottom (equivalent to 180deg).

column1: In CSS Grid, what does grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) specify?
column2: It divides the grid container into exactly three equal-width flexible fractional tracks.

column1: How does 1fr differ from 33.33% in CSS Grid?
column2: 1fr distributes leftover free space after accounting for gaps and fixed track sizing, preventing horizontal scrollbar overflow bugs.

column1: What is the minimum recommended touch target size specified by WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 2.5.5 for mobile controls?
column2: 44px by 44px (with 48px by 48px widely recommended for touch ergonomics).

column1: What is the minimum contrast ratio required by WCAG 2.1 AA for standard body text against its background?
column2: 4.5:1 (Level AA standard).

column1: What is the minimum contrast ratio required by WCAG 2.1 AA for large text (18pt / 24px regular or 14pt / 18.66px bold)?
column2: 3.0:1 (Level AA standard).

column1: Why does the hero badge use --color-primary-dark (#E05A00) instead of --color-primary (#FF6B00) on light orange backgrounds?
column2: To satisfy the WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast ratio threshold against the light background (#FFF4EC).

column1: What HTML5 landmark element represents the dominant introductory content of the document body?
column2: The <header> element or the top <section> within <main>.

column1: What is the accessibility purpose of aria-labelledby="hero-title" on a <section>?
column2: It programmatically establishes the accessible name of the section landmark using the referenced heading element's text.

column1: What attribute on an external <a> tag prevents security vulnerabilities like tabnabbing when using target="_blank"?
column2: rel="noopener noreferrer"

column1: In URL encoding, what does %20 or + represent in a query string?
column2: A whitespace (space) character.

column1: In URL query parameters, what does the percent-encoded sequence %2C represent?
column2: A comma character (,).

column1: In URL query parameters, what does the percent-encoded sequence %27 represent?
column2: An apostrophe / single quote character (').

column1: In CSS, what selector pseudo-class matches when an element receives keyboard navigation focus without showing on mouse clicks?
column2: :focus-visible

column1: What CSS property controls the outline spacing from an element's border box without affecting layout flow?
column2: outline-offset (e.g., outline-offset: 2px;).

column1: In CSS Flexbox, what property controls whether flex items wrap onto multiple lines when container space is insufficient?
column2: flex-wrap (e.g., flex-wrap: wrap;).

column1: Why is active pseudo-class transform: scale(0.98) applied to buttons?
column2: To provide tactile visual feedback simulating physical button compression on click or tap.

column1: What happens in the Critical Rendering Path when an element's box-shadow changes on hover?
column2: The browser creates a Paint operation to re-render the shadow pixels, but avoids a full Layout reflow.

column1: How does letter-spacing: -0.03em affect large hero headlines?
column2: It tightens character tracking proportionally to font size, improving typographic density and visual cohesion on large display text.
